basis: P16 development realization rates of BXY_GEN_V21B (waves wB, wC); no model output was used
custody: generated only after FROZEN_MODELS.json and CONFIRM_ANALYSIS.json are committed; disjoint from BD_GEN_V1, the 34 exposed test roots, bxyg2pilot, bxyg2confirm (P15 plan, superseded, never generated) and bxyg21dev

precision.primary_population: initially infeasible roots WITH a verified repair (availability reported separately)

rules.budget_failures: certified vs fixed-budget negatives reported per stratum; no impossibility claim from budget failures
rules.censored: administrative kills are CENSORED (absent), never 0; attempted budget failures are operational 0
rules.clustering: each root is its own family; paired family bootstrap B = 10000
rules.rejects: a rejected slot is NOT replaced by a different spec; every construction attempt and validation reject is recorded
rules.shortfall: if realized repairable < 60 or K>=2 < 24 the confirmatory analysis is still run once on what exists and labelled UNDERPOWERED; no additional wave may be generated after any test-model look
rules.stops: fixed slot count; one collection; one evaluation; no interim look at labels or model outputs
